title: Vibhishana explains the prowess of Prahasta
introduction: On Rama's enquiry, Vibhishana explains the prowess of Prahasta who entered the battle-field. The demons with their arrows and the monkeys with their stones combat each other. Both the monkeys and demons were killed in the battle. Prahasta the demon and Nila the monkey come face to face to fight. Prahasta hurls a volley of darts over Nila. Nila kills Prahasta's horses by hurling a huge tree and breaks his bow. Finally a huge rock hurled by Nila breaks Prahasta's head into myriad pieces and dies. All the other demons abandon the battle-field and return to Lanka.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 58th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तम् दृष्ट्वा रणकृतोद्यमम् |
उवाच पस्मितं रामो विभीषणमरिंदमः
verses.iast:
tataḥ prahastaṃ niryāntam dṛṣṭvā raṇakṛtodyamam |
uvāca pasmitaṃ rāmo vibhīṣaṇamariṃdamaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing Prahasta setting out with a martial ardour, Rama the conqueror of enemies, smiling, spoke to Vibhishana as follows:

glosses.meaning: Rama arindamaH = the conqueror of enemies

verses.devanagari:
क एष सुमहाकायो बलेन महता वृतः |
आगच्छति महावेगः किम्रूपबलपौरुषः
आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो वीर्यवन्तम् निशाचरम् |
verses.iast:
ka eṣa sumahākāyo balena mahatā vṛtaḥ |
āgacchati mahāvegaḥ kimrūpabalapauruṣaḥ
ācakṣva me mahābāho vīryavantam niśācaram |
verses.translation: "Who is he with a very huge body, coming with a great speed along with a large army? O, the mighty armed! Tell me about this strong demon."

verses.devanagari:
राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः
एष सेनापतिस्तस्य प्रहस्तो नाम राक्ससः |
लङ्कायाम् राक्षसेन्द्रस्य त्रिभागबलसंवृतः
वीर्यवानस्त्रविच्छूरः सुप्रख्यातपराक्रमः |
verses.iast:
rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
eṣa senāpatistasya prahasto nāma rāksasaḥ |
laṇ^kāyām rākṣasendrasya tribhāgabalasaṃvṛtaḥ
vīryavānastravicchūraḥ suprakhyātaparākramaḥ |
verses.translation: Hearing Rama's words, Vibhishana replied as follows "He is guarded by two-thirds of the army of Lanka. He is a demon of prowess, skilled in the use of mystic weapons and valiant. He is the demon named Prahasta, the Army general of Ravana."

glosses.meaning: who is guarded by two thirds of the army
skilled in the use of weapons

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रहस्तम् निर्यान्तम् भीमम् भीम पराक्रमम्
गर्जन्तम् सुमहा कायम् राक्षसैर् अभिसम्वृतम् |
ददर्श महती सेना वानराणाम् बलीयसाम्
अभिसम्जात रोषाणाम् प्रहस्तम् अभिगर्जताम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ prahastam niryāntam bhīmam bhīma parākramam
garjantam sumahā kāyam rākṣasair abhisamvṛtam |
dadarśa mahatī senā vānarāṇām balīyasām
abhisamjāta roṣāṇām prahastam abhigarjatām |
verses.translation: That huge and powerful army of monkeys, who began to emit cries of defiance with fury, thereupon saw the terrible Prahasta of formidable exploits coming forth towards them.

verses.devanagari:
खड्ग शक्त्य् अष्टि बाणाश् च शूलानि मुसलानि च
गदाश्च परिघाह् प्रासा विविधाश् च परश्वधाः |
धनूम्षि च विचित्राणि राक्षसानाम् जय एषिणाम्
प्रगृहीतान्य् अशोभन्त वानरान् अभिधावताम् |
verses.iast:
khaḍga śakty aṣṭi bāṇāś ca śūlāni musalāni ca
gadāśca parighāh prāsā vividhāś ca paraśvadhāḥ |
dhanūmṣi ca vicitrāṇi rākṣasānām jaya eṣiṇām
pragṛhītāny aśobhanta vānarān abhidhāvatām |
verses.translation: Swords, lances, daggers, darts, spears, clubs, maces bars, barbed missiles, various kinds of axes and different bows glittered in the hands of demons, who were running up towards the monkeys and seeking victory.

verses.devanagari:
जगृहुः पादपांश् च अपि पुष्पितान् वानर ऋषभाः
शिलाश्च विपुला दीर्घा योद्धु कामाह् प्लवम् गमाः |
verses.iast:
jagṛhuḥ pādapāṃś ca api puṣpitān vānara ṛṣabhāḥ
śilāśca vipulā dīrghā yoddhu kāmāh plavam gamāḥ |
verses.translation: The monkeys who were burning to fight took hold of trees in flower, rocks and lofty and thick stones.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् अन्योन्यम् आसाद्य सम्ग्रामह् सुमहान् अभूत्
बहूनाम् अश्म वृष्टिम् च शर वृष्टिम् च वर्षताम् |
verses.iast:
teṣām anyonyam āsādya samgrāmah sumahān abhūt
bahūnām aśma vṛṣṭim ca śara vṛṣṭim ca varṣatām |
verses.translation: As they approached each other, a very great battle arose between those combatants who showered down a hail of arrows and a bombardment of stones.

verses.devanagari:
बहवो राक्षसा युद्धे बहून् वानर यूथपान्
वानरा राक्षसांश् च अपि निजघ्नुर् बहवो बहून् |
verses.iast:
bahavo rākṣasā yuddhe bahūn vānara yūthapān
vānarā rākṣasāṃś ca api nijaghnur bahavo bahūn |
verses.translation: In that battle, many of the demons killed several excellent monkeys and several monkeys killed many of the demons.

verses.devanagari:
शूलैः प्रमथिताह् केचित् केचित् तु परम आयुधैः
परिघैर् आहताह् केचित् केचिच् चिन्नाह् परश्वधैः |
verses.iast:
śūlaiḥ pramathitāh kecit kecit tu parama āyudhaiḥ
parighair āhatāh kecit kecic cinnāh paraśvadhaiḥ |
verses.translation: Some monkeys were smashed by spears and some others by finer weapons. Some were struck by iron bars and some others were slit by axes.

verses.devanagari:
निरुच्च्वासाह् पुनह् केचित् पतिता धरणी तले
विभिन्न हृदयाह् केचिद् इषु सम्तान संदिताः |
verses.iast:
niruccvāsāh punah kecit patitā dharaṇī tale
vibhinna hṛdayāh kecid iṣu samtāna saṃditāḥ |
verses.translation: Yet again, some fell breathlessly on the ground and some were destroyed by the arrows aimed at them with their hearts splits asunder.

glosses.meaning: on the surface of the earth
were destroyed by the arrows aimed at them

verses.devanagari:
केचिद् द्विधा कृताह् खड्गैः स्फुरन्तः पतिता भुवि
वानरा राक्षसैः शूलैः पार्श्वतश् च विदारिताः |
verses.iast:
kecid dvidhā kṛtāh khaḍgaiḥ sphurantaḥ patitā bhuvi
vānarā rākṣasaiḥ śūlaiḥ pārśvataś ca vidāritāḥ |
verses.translation: Cut into two with the strokes of swords by those powerful demons, some monkeys, trembling, fell on the earth, their sides torn open.

verses.devanagari:
वानरैसः च अपि सम्क्रुद्धै राक्षस ओघाः समन्ततः
पादपैर् गिरि शृन्गैश् च सम्पिष्टा वसुधा तले |
verses.iast:
vānaraisḥ ca api samkruddhai rākṣasa oghāḥ samantataḥ
pādapair giri śṛngaiś ca sampiṣṭā vasudhā tale |
verses.translation: Even the flock of demons on all sides were crushed on to the earth by the furious monkeys with tree and mountain-peaks.

verses.devanagari:
वज्र स्पर्श तलैर् हस्तैर् मुष्टिभिश् च हता भृशम्
वमन् शोणितम् आस्येभ्यो विशीर्ण दशन ईक्षणः |
verses.iast:
vajra sparśa talair hastair muṣṭibhiś ca hatā bhṛśam
vaman śoṇitam āsyebhyo viśīrṇa daśana īkṣaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: Having been administered thundering slaps with their hands and terrific blows with their fists, the faces and eyes of demons were were lacerated. The demons vomited plenty of blood from their months.

glosses.meaning: having been administered thundering slaps with their hands
the faces and eyes of demons were lacerated

verses.devanagari:
आर्त स्वरम् च स्वनताम् सिम्ह नादम् च नर्दताम्
बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो हरीणाम् रक्षसाम् युधि |
verses.iast:
ārta svaram ca svanatām simha nādam ca nardatām
babhūva tumulaḥ śabdo harīṇām rakṣasām yudhi |
verses.translation: A tumultuous clamour arose among monkeys and demons, as cries of pain and leonine roars were bellowed.

verses.devanagari:
वानरा राक्षसाह् क्रुद्धा वीर मार्गम् अनुव्रताः
विवृत्त नयनाह् क्रूराश् चक्रुह् कर्माण्य् अभीतवत् |
verses.iast:
vānarā rākṣasāh kruddhā vīra mārgam anuvratāḥ
vivṛtta nayanāh krūrāś cakruh karmāṇy abhītavat |
verses.translation: The monkeys and the demons with anger, following the path of heroes, with their cruel and hostile eyes, accomplished their deeds with great courage.

verses.devanagari:
नर अन्तकः कुम्भ हनुर् महा नादह् समुन्नतः
एते प्रहस्त सचिवाह् सर्वे जघ्नुर् वन ओकसः |
verses.iast:
nara antakaḥ kumbha hanur mahā nādah samunnataḥ
ete prahasta sacivāh sarve jaghnur vana okasaḥ |
verses.translation: Narantaka Kumbhahanu, Mahanada and Samunnata all these companions of Prahasta killed the monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् आपतताम् शीघ्रम् निघ्नताम् च अपि वानरान्
द्विविदो गिरि शृन्गेण जघान एकम् नर अन्तकम् |
verses.iast:
teṣām āpatatām śīghram nighnatām ca api vānarān
dvivido giri śṛngeṇa jaghāna ekam nara antakam |
verses.translation: Dvivida, with a mountain-peak, struck down Narantaka, the one among them who was rushing upon quickly and killing the monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
दुर्मुखः पुनर् उत्पाट्य कपिः स विपुल द्रुमम्
राक्षसम् क्षिप्र हस्तस् तु समुन्नतम् अपोथयत् |
verses.iast:
durmukhaḥ punar utpāṭya kapiḥ sa vipula drumam
rākṣasam kṣipra hastas tu samunnatam apothayat |
verses.translation: The ape Durmukha on his part, with a ready hand, uprooted a very large tree and crushed the demon Samunnata.

verses.devanagari:
जाम्बवांस् तु सुसम्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीम् शिलाम्
पातयाम् आस तेजस्वी महा नादस्य वक्षसि |
verses.iast:
jāmbavāṃs tu susamkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatīm śilām
pātayām āsa tejasvī mahā nādasya vakṣasi |
verses.translation: The energetic Jambavan with a great fury seized a huge rock and threw it on the chest-region of Mahanada.

verses.devanagari:
अथ कुम्भ हनुस् तत्र तारेण आसाद्य वीर्यवान्
वृक्षेण अभिहतो मूर्ध्नि प्राणांस् तत्याज राक्षसः |
verses.iast:
atha kumbha hanus tatra tāreṇa āsādya vīryavān
vṛkṣeṇa abhihato mūrdhni prāṇāṃs tatyāja rākṣasaḥ |
verses.translation: Then, the valiant Kumbhahanu there in the battle, having attacked the General Tara, who was armed with a huge tree, received a blow immediately cost him his life.

glosses.meaning: (who was armed) with a huge tree

verses.devanagari:
अमृष्यमाणस् तत् कर्म प्रहस्तो रथम् आस्थितः
चकार कदनम् घोरम् धनुष् पाणिर् वन ओकसाम् |
verses.iast:
amṛṣyamāṇas tat karma prahasto ratham āsthitaḥ
cakāra kadanam ghoram dhanuṣ pāṇir vana okasām |
verses.translation: Not tolerating the aforesaid act, Prahasta having occupied his chariot with bow in hand, caused a terrible havoc among the monkeys.

glosses.meaning: with the bow in his hand

verses.devanagari:
आवर्त;इव सम्जज्ने;उभयोह् सेनयोस् तदा
क्षुभितस्य अप्रमेयस्य सागरस्य इव निस्वनः |
verses.iast:
āvarta;iva samjajne;ubhayoh senayos tadā
kṣubhitasya aprameyasya sāgarasya iva nisvanaḥ |
verses.translation: Then, with the rapid movement of both the armies, there arose of clamour resembling the roar of an unfathomable and tempestuous ocean in a time of dissolution.

glosses.meaning: resembling the roar of an ocean

verses.devanagari:
महता हि शर ओघेण प्रहस्तो युद्ध कोविदः
अर्दयाम् आस सम्क्रुद्धो वानरान् परम आहवे |
verses.iast:
mahatā hi śara ogheṇa prahasto yuddha kovidaḥ
ardayām āsa samkruddho vānarān parama āhave |
verses.translation: The demon Prahasta, who was hard to be subdued in battle, with full of anger, tormented the monkeys by an immense avalanche of arrows in that great combat.

glosses.meaning: who was hard to be subdued in battle
by an immense avalanche of arrows

verses.devanagari:
वानराणाम् शरीरैस् तु राक्षसानाम् च मेदिनी
बभूव निचिता घोरा पतितैर् इव पर्वतैः |
verses.iast:
vānarāṇām śarīrais tu rākṣasānām ca medinī
babhūva nicitā ghorā patitair iva parvataiḥ |
verses.translation: By the frightening corpses of monkeys and demons, appearing like hideous mountains, a very extensive area of the ground is covered.

verses.devanagari:
सा मही रुधिर ओघेण प्रच्चन्ना सम्प्रकाशते
संचन्ना माधवे मासि पलाशैर् इव पुष्पितैः |
verses.iast:
sā mahī rudhira ogheṇa praccannā samprakāśate
saṃcannā mādhave māsi palāśair iva puṣpitaiḥ |
verses.translation: That ground, covered by the stream of blood, shone as in the month of spring when overspread fully with the bloossoming crimson-coloured Palasa flowers.

glosses.meaning: as in the month of spring

verses.devanagari:
हरि वीर ओघ वप्राम् तु भग्न आयुध महा द्रुमाम्
शोणित ओघ महा तोयाम् यम सागर गामिनीम् |
यकृत् प्लीह महा पन्काम् विनिकीर्ण अन्त्र शैबलाम्
भिन्न काय शिरो मीनाम् अन्ग अवयव शाड्वलाम् |
गृध्र हंस गण आकीर्णाम् कन्क सारस सेविताम्
मेधः फेन समाकीर्णाम् आर्त स्तनित निस्वनाम् |
ताम् कापुरुष दुस्ताराम् युद्ध भूमिमयीम् नदीम्
नदीम् इव घन अपाये हंस सारस सेविताम् |
राक्षसाह् कपि मुख्याश् च तेरुस् ताम् दुस्तराम् नदीम्
यथा पद्म रजो ध्वस्ताम् नलिनीम् गज यूथपाः |
verses.iast:
hari vīra ogha vaprām tu bhagna āyudha mahā drumām
śoṇita ogha mahā toyām yama sāgara gāminīm |
yakṛt plīha mahā pankām vinikīrṇa antra śaibalām
bhinna kāya śiro mīnām anga avayava śāḍvalām |
gṛdhra haṃsa gaṇa ākīrṇām kanka sārasa sevitām
medhaḥ phena samākīrṇām ārta stanita nisvanām |
tām kāpuruṣa dustārām yuddha bhūmimayīm nadīm
nadīm iva ghana apāye haṃsa sārasa sevitām |
rākṣasāh kapi mukhyāś ca terus tām dustarām nadīm
yathā padma rajo dhvastām nalinīm gaja yūthapāḥ |
verses.translation: With the heaps of warriors for its banks the broken weapons its trees, the torrents of blood its huge waves, death appeared like an ocean receiving its floods, livers and spleens its mire, entrails its moss, severed heads and trunks the fish, and morsels of flesh the grass, the innumerable vultures its lovely swans, herons its geese, covered as it was with fat for the foam, the tumult the sound of its waters, the battle field resembled a river, incapable of being crossed by cowards, visited by water-fowls at the end of the rainy season, those demons and the foremost of the monkeys crossed over that impassable river, as elephants lead their herds across a lake that the lotuses have covered with pollen.

glosses.meaning: with the heaps of warriors for its banks
the torrents of blood its huge waves
death appeared like an ocean receiving its flood
the scattered entrails for its moss
severed heads and trunks the fish
the innumerable vultures its lovely swans
covered as it was with fat for the foam
the tumult the sound of its waters
incapable of being crossed by cowards
at the end of the rainy season
and the foremost of the monkeys
that the lotuses have covered with pollen..

verses.devanagari:
ततः सृजन्तम् बाण ओघान् प्रहस्तम् स्यन्दने स्थितम्
ददर्श तरसा नीलो विनिघ्नन्तम् प्लवम् गमान् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ sṛjantam bāṇa oghān prahastam syandane sthitam
dadarśa tarasā nīlo vinighnantam plavam gamān |
verses.translation: Then, Nila saw Prahasta who was employing a multitude of arrows sitting in the chariot and annihilating the monkeys swiftly.

verses.devanagari:
उद्धूत इव वायुः खे महादभ्रबलं बलात्
समीक्ष्याभिद्रुतम् युद्धे प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः |
रथेनादित्यवर्णेन नीलमेवाभिदुद्रुवे
verses.iast:
uddhūta iva vāyuḥ khe mahādabhrabalaṃ balāt
samīkṣyābhidrutam yuddhe prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ |
rathenādityavarṇena nīlamevābhidudruve
verses.translation: Seeing Nila who was running towards him in the battle-field, as a rocking wind in the sky rushes towards a large massive clouds, Prahasta the Army general attacked Nila himself with his chariot having the sun's colour.

glosses.meaning: seeing abhidrutam = Nila who was running towards him

verses.devanagari:
स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठो विकृष्य परमाहवे
नीलाय व्यसृजद्बाणान् प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः |
verses.iast:
sa dhanurdhanvināṃ śreṣṭho vikṛṣya paramāhave
nīlāya vyasṛjadbāṇān prahasto vāhinīpatiḥ |
verses.translation: That Prahasta the Army General, who was excellent among the wielders of bow, drew the bow-string and hurled the arrows towards Nila in that great battle.

verses.devanagari:
ते प्रेत्य निशिखा नीलं विनिर्भिद्य समाहिताः
महीम् जग्मुर्महावेगा रोषिता इव पन्नगाः |
verses.iast:
te pretya niśikhā nīlaṃ vinirbhidya samāhitāḥ
mahīm jagmurmahāvegā roṣitā iva pannagāḥ |
verses.translation: Those arrows with a great speed resembling furious snakes employed by Prahasta proceeded towards Nila, pierced him and fell on the ground.

verses.devanagari:
नीलः शरैरभिहतो निशितैर्ज्वलनोपमैः
स तम् परम दुर्धर्षम् आपतन्तम् महा कपिः |
प्रहस्तम् ताडयाम् आस वृक्षम् उत्पाट्य वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
nīlaḥ śarairabhihato niśitairjvalanopamaiḥ
sa tam parama durdharṣam āpatantam mahā kapiḥ |
prahastam tāḍayām āsa vṛkṣam utpāṭya vīryavān
verses.translation: That great ape of prowess Nila, who was struck by sharp arrows resembling flames, uprooted a tree and thumped it on the descending Prahasta who was most difficult to be assaulted.

glosses.meaning: who was most difficult to be assaulted

verses.devanagari:
तस्य बाणगणानेव राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः |
अपारयन् वारयितुम् प्रत्यगृह्णान् निमीलितः
verses.iast:
tasya bāṇagaṇāneva rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ |
apārayan vārayitum pratyagṛhṇān nimīlitaḥ
verses.translation: Being unable to restrain the series of arrows hurled at him by that evil-minded demon, nila received them with closed eyes.

verses.devanagari:
यथैव गो वृषो वर्षम् शारदम् शीघ्रमागतम् |
एवम् एव प्रहस्तस्य शर वर्षम् दुरासदम्
निमीलित अक्षः सहसा नीलः सेहे सुदारुणम् |
verses.iast:
yathaiva go vṛṣo varṣam śāradam śīghramāgatam |
evam eva prahastasya śara varṣam durāsadam
nimīlita akṣaḥ sahasā nīlaḥ sehe sudāruṇam |
verses.translation: Like a bull standing under a sudden autumnal down-pour, so under that intolerable and sudden rain of darts released by Prahasta, Nila endured with closed eyes though it was scarce to be endured.

glosses.meaning: though it was scarce to be endured.

verses.devanagari:
रोषितः शर वर्षेण सालेन महता महान् |
प्रजघान हयान् नीलह् प्रहस्तस्य मनो जवान्
verses.iast:
roṣitaḥ śara varṣeṇa sālena mahatā mahān |
prajaghāna hayān nīlah prahastasya mano javān
verses.translation: The exceedingly strong and the great Nila, enraged over the volley of darts, killed Prahasta's horses by hurling a huge Sala tree on them.

verses.devanagari:
ततो रोषपरीतात्मा धनुस्तस्य दुरात्मनः |
बभञ्ज तरसा नीलो ननाद च पुनः पुनः
verses.iast:
tato roṣaparītātmā dhanustasya durātmanaḥ |
babhaJṇja tarasā nīlo nanāda ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the greatly enraged Nila quickly broke the bow of Prahasta the evil-minded demon and shouted again and again.

verses.devanagari:
विधनुस् तु कृतस् तेन प्रहस्तो वाहिनी पतिः |
प्रगृह्य मुसलम् घोरम् स्यन्दनाद् अवपुप्लुवे
verses.iast:
vidhanus tu kṛtas tena prahasto vāhinī patiḥ |
pragṛhya musalam ghoram syandanād avapupluve
verses.translation: Deprived of his bow, Prahasta the leader of the army, seizing a formidable mace, leapt down from the chariot.

verses.devanagari:
ताव् उभौ वाहिनी मुख्यौ जात रोषौ तरस्विनौ |
स्थितौ क्षतज दिग्ध अन्गौ प्रभिन्नाव् इव कुन्जरौ
verses.iast:
tāv ubhau vāhinī mukhyau jāta roṣau tarasvinau |
sthitau kṣataja digdha angau prabhinnāv iva kunjarau
verses.translation: Those two army-chiefs, who were courageous and in whom enmity had sprung up, with their limbs covered with blood, wee standing like two elephants in rut.

glosses.meaning: in whom enmity had sprung up

verses.devanagari:
उल्लिखन्तौ सुतीक्ष्णाभिर् दम्ष्ट्राभिर् इतरेतरम् |
सिम्ह शार्दूल सदृशौ सिम्ह शार्दूल चेष्टितौ
विक्रान्त विजयौ वीरौ समरेष्व् अनिवर्तिनौ |
कान्क्षमाणौ यशः प्राप्तुम् वृत्र वासवयोः समौ
verses.iast:
ullikhantau sutīkṣṇābhir damṣṭrābhir itaretaram |
simha śārdūla sadṛśau simha śārdūla ceṣṭitau
vikrānta vijayau vīrau samareṣv anivartinau |
kānkṣamāṇau yaśaḥ prāptum vṛtra vāsavayoḥ samau
verses.translation: Lion and tiger in gait, lion and tiger in gestures, those two warriors tore each other with their shap teeth. Vanquishers of other heroes and intrepid combatants, both of them, thirsting for fame, resembled Vritra and Indra.

glosses.meaning: and those who did not flee

verses.devanagari:
आजघान तदा नीलम् ललाटे मुसलेन सः |
प्रहस्तः परम् आयस्तस् तस्य सुस्राव शोणितम्
verses.iast:
ājaghāna tadā nīlam lalāṭe musalena saḥ |
prahastaḥ param āyastas tasya susrāva śoṇitam
verses.translation: Then, that Prahasta exerting himself well struck Nila on his forehead with a mace and blood oozed from his forehead.

verses.devanagari:
ततः शोणित दिग्ध अन्गह् प्रगृह्य सुमहा तरुम् |
प्रहस्तस्य उरसि क्रुद्धो विससर्ज महा कपिः
verses.iast:
tataḥ śoṇita digdha angah pragṛhya sumahā tarum |
prahastasya urasi kruddho visasarja mahā kapiḥ
verses.translation: Whereupon, that great ape, his limbs smeared with blood, seized a huge tree and struck Prahasta full in his chest with fury.

glosses.meaning: with his limbed smeared with blood

verses.devanagari:
तम् अचिन्त्य प्रहारम् स प्रगृह्य मुसलम् महत् |
अभिदुद्राव बलिनम् बली नीलम् प्लवम् गमम्
verses.iast:
tam acintya prahāram sa pragṛhya musalam mahat |
abhidudrāva balinam balī nīlam plavam gamam
verses.translation: Ignoring that blow, he seized a huge mace and ran in strength towards Nila the strong monkey.

verses.devanagari:
तम् उग्र वेगम् सम्रब्धम् आपतन्तम् महा कपिः |
ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य जग्राह महा वेगो महा शिलाम्
verses.iast:
tam ugra vegam samrabdham āpatantam mahā kapiḥ |
tataḥ samprekṣya jagrāha mahā vego mahā śilām
verses.translation: Seeing Prahasta of terrible velocity briskly rushing towards him, Nila the great monkey took a huge rock swiftly.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य युद्ध अभिकामस्य मृधे मुसल योधिनः |
प्रहस्तस्य शिलाम् नीलो मूर्ध्नि तूर्णम् अपातयत्
verses.iast:
tasya yuddha abhikāmasya mṛdhe musala yodhinaḥ |
prahastasya śilām nīlo mūrdhni tūrṇam apātayat
verses.translation: Nila quickly hurled that rock on the head of Prahasta who was longing for war and fighting with a mace in the battle.

verses.devanagari:
नीलेन कपिमुख्येन विमुक्ता महती शिला |
बिभेद बहुधा घोरा प्रहस्तस्य शिरस् तदा
verses.iast:
nīlena kapimukhyena vimuktā mahatī śilā |
bibheda bahudhā ghorā prahastasya śiras tadā
verses.translation: Then, that huge and terrific rock hurled by Nila the leader of the monkeys broke Prahasa's head into myriad pieces.

verses.devanagari:
स गत असुर् गत श्रीको गत सत्त्वो गत इन्द्रियः |
पपात सहसा भूमौ चिन्न मूल;इव द्रुमः
verses.iast:
sa gata asur gata śrīko gata sattvo gata indriyaḥ |
papāta sahasā bhūmau cinna mūla;iva drumaḥ
verses.translation: That Prahasta who lost his breath, was disfigured and dead, bereft of his senses and at once fell on the ground like a tree cut up by the root.

verses.devanagari:
विभिन्न शिरसस् तस्य बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् |
शरीराद् अपि सुस्राव गिरेह् प्रस्रवणम् यथा
verses.iast:
vibhinna śirasas tasya bahu susrāva śoṇitam |
śarīrād api susrāva gireh prasravaṇam yathā
verses.translation: A lot of blood oozed from his broken head. From his body two, blood streamed forth like a cascade from a mountain.

verses.devanagari:
हते प्रहस्ते नीलेन तद् अकम्प्यम् महद् बलम् |
रक्षसाम् अप्रहृष्टानाम् लन्काम् अभिजगाम ह
verses.iast:
hate prahaste nīlena tad akampyam mahad balam |
rakṣasām aprahṛṣṭānām lankām abhijagāma ha
verses.translation: Thier leader having been slain by Nila that unshakable and large army of demons, becoming disconsolated, withdrew to Lanka.

verses.devanagari:
न शेकुः समवस्थातुम् निहते वाहिनी पतौ |
सेतु बन्धम् समासाद्य विशीर्णम् सलिलम् यथा
verses.iast:
na śekuḥ samavasthātum nihate vāhinī patau |
setu bandham samāsādya viśīrṇam salilam yathā
verses.translation: Thier chief of Army having been killed, those demons could not continue to stand firmy there, any more than water on reaching a breached bridge.

verses.devanagari:
हते तस्मिंसः चमू मुख्ये राक्षसस् ते निरुद्यमाः |
रक्षः पति गृहम् गत्वा ध्यान मूकत्वम् आगताः
प्रप्ताः शोकार्णावम् तीव्रम् विसम्ज्ञा इव ते.भवन् |
verses.iast:
hate tasmiṃsḥ camū mukhye rākṣasas te nirudyamāḥ |
rakṣaḥ pati gṛham gatvā dhyāna mūkatvam āgatāḥ
praptāḥ śokārṇāvam tīvram visamjJṇā iva te.bhavan |
verses.translation: That Prahasta the chief of Army having been slain, those demons dumb dispirited and inactive, regained the abode of their king. They became unconscious as it were plunged in an ocean of burning grief.

glosses.meaning: in an ocean of burning grief.

verses.devanagari:
ततस् तु नीलो विजयी महा बलः |
प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा |
समेत्य रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन |
प्रहृष्ट रूपस् तु बभूव यूथपः
verses.iast:
tatas tu nīlo vijayī mahā balaḥ |
praśasyamānaḥ svakṛtena karmaṇā |
sametya rāmeṇa salakṣmaṇena |
prahṛṣṭa rūpas tu babhūva yūthapaḥ
verses.translation: The triumphant Nila, however, was honoured by Rama and Lakshmana for his task well accomplished and experienced supreme joy.
